content.text:
=== confirm core install.core.inc is pristine (matches git) ===
=== remove stray debug files ===
no stray batch logs in /workspace
=== example.org created by create-project (keep it) ===
/workspace/example.org

observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== confirm core install.core.inc is pristine (matches git) ==="
git status --short web/core/includes/install.core.inc 2>&1
git diff --stat 2>&1 | head
echo "=== remove stray debug files ==="
rm -f /workspace/batch_*.log /workspace/web/batch_*.log .batch_debug.log web/.batch_debug.log 2>/dev/null
ls /workspace/batch_*.log 2>/dev/null || echo "no stray batch logs in /workspace"
echo "=== example.org created by create-project (keep it) ==="
ls -d /workspace/example.org 2>/dev/null
